exercises.q: We'll have to fall back on our reserves.
exercises.why: **прибегнуть** — прибе́гнуть (perfective): to resort, to have recourse, to fall back (upon). Wiktionary: при- + бегнуть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **избежал** — избежа́ть (perfective): to avoid, to refrain from; to keep off, to steer clear of, to shun, to evade, to elude; to escape. Wiktionary: из- + бежа́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **разбежались** — разбежа́ться (perfective): to scatter; to take a run, to run up (before jumping, diving, etc). Wiktionary: раз- + бежа́ть + -ся.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to get by running or as if by running
to run (to; as far as), to reach
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: разбежа́ться — to scatter; забежа́ть — to get by running or as if by running; добежа́ть — to run (to; as far as), to reach; избе́гнуть — to avoid, to refrain from.

exercises.q: I reached school before the rain started.
exercises.ru: Я ___ до школы прежде, чем начался дождь.
exercises.why: **добежал** — добежа́ть (perfective): to run (to; as far as), to reach. Wiktionary: до- + бежа́ть.

exercises.q: I'll bet that I can beat you to the tree.

exercises.why: **добегу** — добежа́ть (perfective): to run (to; as far as), to reach. Wiktionary: до- + бежа́ть.
